summary: Moved engine classification to orch and added phase 1e (story writer + 3P critic) before Agent 5. SDR reshape: classification.json is the only identity (no stamp copy onto narrative_bind); lock is narrative_3p.verdict=PASS; Agent 5 is compute-only (story_input_bind + buyer_dials, no FDD/oppath re-walk); evidence_hooks must map or reject each id'd finding. Stamps < 3.4.0 skip 1e.
follow_ups: Flip Street FY+1 from default Y1 to restory/cross-check (user did not take this in this increment)
Take Agent 4 and Agent 12 off the default path
Typed uncertainty instead of a >=5 stress quota
risks: New 3.4.0 runs fail until the orchestrator writes classification.json and spawns story then 3p; prompts, schemas, and preflight were updated in the same change set
All new gates are version-gated at >= 3.4.0, so sessions stamped <= 3.3.0 (archived history and fixtures) stay green
3P FAIL loops are orchestrator-owned (max 2); the machine only blocks Agent 5 until verdict=PASS and status=locked
